dysfunction.name: Working Memory Overload
dysfunction.mechanism_text: Working memory capacity limits the amount of information that can be held active and manipulated simultaneously. When complex, multi-element information exceeds ~4 chunks, working memory is overloaded, resulting in degraded task performance, disorientation, and cognitive fatigue.

behavior.name: Non-deterministic Output
behavior.description: The assistant provides structurally inconsistent or contradictory outputs across repeated invocations of the same or similar prompts.
